snippet.title: Streets of Rage 4 - Floyd Iraia & Multiplayer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/985890/Streets_of_Rage_4/  
PS4 USA: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1482-CUSA16237_00-00STREETSOFRAGE4
Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/streets-of-rage-4-switch/ 
PS4 EU: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP1470-CUSA16221_00-00STREETSOFRAGE4
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/streets_of_rage_4
Humble Bundle: https://fr.humblebundle.com/store/streets-of-rage-4
Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/p/streets-of-rage-4/9n7h54kncb9n?activetab=pivot:overviewtab

The wait is over! Streets of Rage 4 is now available on PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One for $24,99!

Meet Floyd Iraia, the last Streets of Rage 4 playable character,  who dishes out serious damage with his incredibly strong cybernetic arms. Although Floyd’s movement and health recovery are slower than most, he boasts the longest reach among the playable roster and tremendous power, ensuring any combo he puts an enemy through will be devastating. 

We are also thrilled to announce the iconic series’ return will support two-player online and up to four-player offline co-op when it launches this spring.

Streets of Rage 4 will also make its way on to PC, Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in Spring 2020!
